name: wo-p5-replay
cmd: bun add z3-solver@5.3.3 >/dev/null 2>&1; WO_Z3=1 timeout -s KILL 60 bun research/protocols/engine/wodl.ts given 1000 2>&1 | cut -c1-300; WO_Z3=1 timeout -s KILL 60 bun research/protocols/engine/wodl.ts ghost 1000 2>&1 | tail -3 | cut -c1-300; gunzip -c research/protocols/engine/dumps/wo-td-base.jsonl.gz > /tmp/wo.jsonl; WO_Z3=1 timeout -s KILL 700 bun research/protocols/engine/wodl.ts replay /tmp/wo.jsonl 1000 2>&1 | cut -c1-400 | tail -c 120000

name: wo-p5-e2e
cmd: WO_DL_LOG=1 GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 100 bun research/protocols/engine/wodump.ts consensus_wo_decide 60000 /tmp/wo.jsonl 2>&1 | cut -c1-400 | tail -c 200000
